grid.projection: local tangent plane mapped onto the sphere along great circles (azimuth atan2(e, n), arc length hypot(e, n))

method.horizon: per cell: 0.5 deg azimuth, ray steps 2.5 m to 7000 m then 40.0 m to 250000 m, 5 m DEM near / 80 m DEM far, spherical curvature
method.ephemeris: Sun/Earth position rebuilt in the Moon-fixed frame from ephemeris.json (JPL Horizons at the site centre) and projected into each cell's local frame
method.visibility: visible = el > horizonAt(az), linear interpolation on the cell's horizon (docs/data-contract.md)
method.slope: 25 m baseline (5x5 px mean of the 5 m DEM), central differences

warnings: 57535599 near-field ray samples (<= 7000 m) used the 80 m DEM
